title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs served with a side of exotic spices.

ingredients.name: Exotic spice mix (e.g., garam masala, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, ghee or oil, exotic spice mix, kebab spice blend, salt, black pepper, and green chilies.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve hot with a side of basmati rice, naan bread, or roti.
